model: ecoLine O-DO digital optical dissolved oxygen sensor (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: JUMO ecoLine O-DO type 202613 with RS-485 Modbus RTU (interface description V1.01).
summary: The JUMO ecoLine O-DO is an optical (luminescence) dissolved oxygen sensor with a built-in RS-485 Modbus RTU interface. Measurements are started by the master. This map covers the start command, the measurement status word, temperature and oxygen readings and the compensation inputs.

addressing.note: Tables list the Modbus PDU address in decimal and hex; the value goes into the request unchanged (the example reads the temperature at start address 0x0053).

source.title: JUMO ecoLine O-DO/NTU - Digital sensors for turbidity and oxygen measurement - Modbus interface description
source.pages: Data types and float example ch. 2.5-2.6 (pp. 10-13); serial settings ch. 5.1 (p. 21); O-DO tables pp. 25-27; NTU tables pp. 29-30

notes: Floats are IEEE 754 sent high word first (ABCD); the worked example returns 41 CA 66 66 = 25.3 °C for start address 0x0053.
Measurements are triggered: write a start command to register 1, wait at least 300 ms without any Modbus traffic, poll the status word at 82 until no field reads 7, then read the values.
Integers are unsigned 16-bit, high byte first.

Each 3-bit field: 0 OK, 1 OK but outside sensor spec, 2 OK with reduced accuracy, 3 OK (reserved), 4 failed outside spec, 5 failed (membrane cap missing or damaged), 6 failed (reserved), 7 not yet complete.
Only the values requested by the start command are valid after a cycle; ignore the others.

Compensation values are not saved in the sensor; the master must write them before measuring if they differ from the defaults. Whether the sensor uses its own or the written temperature is chosen in JUMO DSM software.
The membrane is rated for about 1 million measurements, so do not trigger faster than needed.
The document gives the address range 1-247 but does not state a factory default address.

registers.name: Measuring operation status
registers.description: Bits 0-2 temp, 3-5 O2 %Sat, 6-8 mg/l, 9-11 ppm; field value 7 = not done.

registers.name: Compensation temperature
registers.description: Default 25 °C; not stored, resend after power-up.

integration.summary: Write the compensation values (93-98), write 7 to register 1, wait 300 ms, poll register 82 until no 3-bit field equals 7, then read 83-90 as ABCD floats.
integration.enable: Modbus RTU is the sensor's native interface; set the address with JUMO DSM software.
quirks: No Modbus requests are allowed for 300 ms after a start command; requests during that window are ignored.
setup: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; address 1-247.
Wire A/B on M12 pins 5/4; the sensor needs +5 V on pin 1.
gotchas: Resend the compensation values after every power-up; they are not stored.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
